listing.subtitle: Quantitative analysis
listing.long_description: MUSITU Axiom gives ChatGPT users access to a production quantitative runtime for finance, statistics, optimization, time-series analysis, verification, and mathematical computation. Users connect an existing MUSITU Axiom account through OAuth. The public ChatGPT surface does not place investment trades, transfer money, or initiate digital-subscription checkout.

starter_prompts: Analyze this time series for trend, volatility, and structural changes.
Solve this constrained optimization problem and explain the optimum.
Compare Monte Carlo and closed-form results for this quantitative model.
release_notes: OpenAI resubmission candidate: restored and re-certified the public Plugin Gate v4 with 108 public tools backed by 74 certified runtime operations and 30 business-facing quantitative products; OAuth 2.1 authorization-code flow with PKCE S256, metered execution, response minimization, and no digital-subscription commerce on the public ChatGPT surface.

review.commerce_description: MUSITU Axiom does not sell products or process payments on the public ChatGPT surface.
